# Chapter I - Scope {#c1}

## A. Material Outsourcing {#a}

1. Material outsourcing of IT services means arrangements which, if disrupted, have the potential to significantly impact the business operations, reputation, profitability or customer service of the regulated entity.

2. A regulated entity shall not outsource core management functions, including internal audit, compliance, strategic decision making, and decisions on credit sanction.

# Chapter II - Governance {#c2}

## B. Policy and Committee {#b}

3. A regulated entity shall have a Board-approved IT outsourcing policy and shall constitute an IT Strategy Committee that reviews outsourcing arrangements at least once a year.

4. The regulated entity shall maintain a central record of all material outsourcing arrangements, which shall be reviewed and updated periodically and made available to the supervisor on demand.

# Chapter III - Business Continuity {#c3}

## C. Exit Strategy {#c}

5. Every material outsourcing agreement shall contain a clear exit strategy, including the right to terminate the agreement and to have all data and records returned or securely destroyed within a period specified in the agreement.

6. The regulated entity shall ensure that the service provider has a business continuity plan that is tested at least once a year, and shall obtain a copy of the test results.
